newsitem.title: FRANCE: Three Algerian children die of food poisoning.
newsitem.headline: Three Algerian children die of food poisoning.

text.p: Three children died from food poisoning and 12 more people needed medical treatment in a tiny village in northeastern Algeria at the weekend, the official Algerian news agency APS said on Monday.
It said the children, aged three, four and seven, died in the hamlet of Souagui, near Bouhatem, in Mila province.
Specialists in the nearby city of Constantine had ruled out any problem with drinking water and were now analysing a range of food.
